decisions.reason: This airfield lighting control unit is a core infrastructure product with strong strategic fit to the firm's integrated airfield offering and clear launch prominence, so it should remain in the portfolio.

An air situation display strengthens the firm's surveillance and tower-side integration offer and its continued dedicated presentation suggests it supports the move toward intelligent, data-driven airport operations.
The airport systems training program complements installed systems, deepens customer relationships and service revenue, and fits the firm's broad solutions-and-support model.

The airfield ground lighting training course appears narrower and less prominently maintained than the broader training offer, so management would likely fold its resources into the main training program or other core products.
Airport collaboration software directly matches the firm's stated direction toward real-time information sharing and collaborative decision-making, making it strategically important to keep.
The multilateration surveillance system is an advanced, R&D-intensive product that fits the firm's innovation profile and its customers' need for safer, higher-capacity airport operations.
